messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need final signoff for the marketplace landing + partner integrations messaging. Posting the current timeline and ask.
jake: Thanks — can you paste the embargo windows and which partners need logo/quote approval? want to align with comms.
sophie: Hi all — marketing draft is ready for blog + landing. Need legal ok on a short partner quote template. Also need hero image from hardware partner by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Embargo/rollout plan: public blog and landing 2029-04-12 09:00 PT, press outreach 2029-04-12 08:00 PT, partner announce 2029-04-12 08:30 PT (staggered). Hardware partners go live same day but some will want a different time — see notes.
emanuel: For SI integrations we'll have a partner spotlight on the landing. We need logos + one-sentence integration summary per SI. Deadline: 2029-04-05 COB.
ryan: Legal note: we can use partner logos if signed LOA is in place. @natalie — can you confirm we have LOAs for CloudNode and Rackwell?
natalie: I have CloudNode LOA signed. Rackwell still pending — legal reached out yesterday. If we don't have it by 2029-04-04 17:00 PT we should remove Rackwell logo and replace with "integrations coming soon".
sophie: Cool — I'll prepare an alternate hero that doesn't show Rackwell if needed. Also will draft a short quote template for partners to accept quickly.
maria: Small checklist for partner deliverables (please ack):
```
- logo (png/svg) — 1x/2x
- short quote (<=140 chars)
- integration blurb (<=200 chars)
- legal LOA signed
- press contact email
```
jake: Acknowledged. I'll ping the Cloud marketplace PMs to confirm partner press contacts and confirm any co-marketing assets.
emanuel: Ops question: do we have a fallback model variant for the demo on the landing if Dedicated capacity isn't ready? last time dev capacity caused flakiness.
ryan: launch-bot: autoscaling group alerting configured for demo service, will fall back to hosted route if latency > 1.2s for 3 consecutive minutes :robot_face:
maria: Good — please drop in the exact hosted endpoint we should point demo at (no creds in thread). jake can DM.
natalie: About blog language: avoid product claims like "enterprise-grade SLAs" unless we have SLAs for Marketplace tier. I'll mark the draft where that phrasing appears.
sophie: Noted — will remove that sentence and replace with "backed by Redwood's serving platform" unless we have explicit SLA numbers.
jake: One blocker — press contact list needs a verified phone for one regional reporter. @emanuel can you check with partner PR contacts?
emanuel: I'll follow up now, should have it before EOD.
maria: Final signoff plan: marketing to send final assets to partners by 2029-04-04 18:00 PT, legal final check 2029-04-05 12:00 PT, creative assets freeze 2029-04-06 09:00 PT. If any LOA missing at legal cut we'll hide logos and proceed.
sophie: I'll upload hero / meta images to the shared drive and post links in the doc when done. cc @maria
jake: Thanks everyone — small rehearsal tomorrow 09:30 PT in #marketplace-rehearsal. Expect a dry-run of the press timeline and switchovers.
maria: Perfect. If any partner asks for a custom embargo time, flag here immediately. :calendar:
launch-bot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled 2029-03-28 09:30 PT. Join link: https://meet.company/launch-rehearsal :rocket:
